🔄 Content update (published: September 4, 2026 / previous: September 5, 2026)

Report from Staff Dispatched to Kumamoto in Connection with the 2026 Kumamoto Earthquake

Date and time: Tuesday, September 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 1:15 p.m.

Location: Crisis Management Conference Room, 1st floor, Hanno City Hall Annex Building

Two staff members who were dispatched to provide human support to the disaster-affected area (Kumamoto City)—specifically to assist with evacuation center operations and damaged property assessment work—reported on the current situation in the affected area to the mayor.

Dispatched Personnel Support to Affected Area

【Number of personnel and dispatch period】

(Kumamoto City) 2 staff: Monday, August 17, 2026 (Reiwa 8) through Tuesday, August 25, 2026

【Work duties】

• Support for evacuation center operations
• Support for property damage assessment work
• Other duties

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/somubu/bosaikikikanri/bosai/14352.html
